messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High 5xx rate detected for customer Elysian (dedicated VPC pool 'elysian-prod-1') — error rate > 25% over 5m, latency spike. Paging SRE on-call. See: https://internal.monitor/alerts/4267894021 :rotating_light:
Maya (SRE): @here I’m on it. Seeing a spike in tail latency from nodes in pool elysian-prod-1, looks network-y at first glance.
Liam (Eng-Platform): Can you grab the node list and recent deploys? I don’t see any canaries in that pool.
Maya (SRE): Pulling node list now. No deploys in last 12h. Nodes: gpu-12, gpu-13, gpu-14 (zone a), gpu-21 (zone b).
Riley (Eng-Runtime): I’m tailing the runtime logs for gpu-12/gpu-13 — lots of `kv-cache` eviction warnings and OOM-ish traces. Posting snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:17:12Z] runtime WARN kv_cache: eviction_pressure=0.87
[2026-03-15T10:17:13Z] runtime ERROR generation: step_failed: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T10:17:13Z] runtime INFO fallback: enqueuing to model-quantized-v2
```
Maya (SRE): Interesting. Error messages align with 5xxs. Could be a tenant causing huge context growth.
Nora (Customer Success): Heads up — Elysian support ticket just came in. They report degraded throughput for their critical inference path. Major account, SLA implications.
Ethan (Oncall): I’ll start mitigation. Plan: isolate heavy tenant(s), scale dedicated pool up + route new requests to fallback region, enable prefixed KV caching off for that customer's routes.
Sam (Product): Quick Q — do we have safe fallback model variant for elysian workloads? Need to balance quality.
Riley (Eng-Runtime): We have `redwood/model-small-quant` compatible with the api but lower quality. We can auto-fallback per route-config.
Liam (Eng-Platform): I’ll open an emergency routing rule to send traffic to `eu-west-2` spare pool and temporarily increase concurrency limit for elysian-prod-1. Pushing now.
Maya (SRE): Executing isolation: adding `tenant_quarantine: elysian:heavy-session-*` to routing rules to pin suspicious prefixes. Command: `infractl route modify --pool elysian-prod-1 --quarantine 'session:*'`
Maya (SRE): Also scaling pool +2 nodes (gpu-22, gpu-23).
incident-bot: Note: autoscaler triggered manual scale request by Maya (SRE) at 2026-03-15T10:21:40Z.
Riley (Eng-Runtime): After quarantine, I still see a subset of requests with huge sequence lengths — looks like a training-style loop from a misconfigured customer job hitting inference. Example payload length ~2.1M tokens in a single call.
Asha (Security): If it's abusive/misconfiguration, we should treat as tenant isolation and consider temporary creds disable if they do not respond.
Nora (Customer Success): I’m pinging Elysian account team and the customer contacts now: "We're investigating a high-volume job affecting your dedicated pool; temporary mitigation may change latency. We'll follow up with RCA and credits if there is SLA impact."
Ethan (Oncall): Applying temporary per-tenant rate limit: `policy:set elysian max_tokens_per_min=20000` and abort long-lived requests with 429.
Sam (Product): Please confirm we log evidence of the offending requests (payload hashes, timestamps) for the RCA and for any account action.
Riley (Eng-Runtime): Logging enabled; I captured top offender sessions: session id `s-9f4a` with payload_hash `0x7f3b...`. Stored snapshots to /var/incident/4267894021/ for review.
Maya (SRE): Post-mitigation, error rate dropped to ~3% and latency back to baseline ~120ms avg. Monitoring for 15m.
incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: error rate below threshold for elysian-prod-1 at 2026-03-15T10:37:05Z.
Nora (Customer Success): Emailed the customer with an interim update and asked for confirmation about whether they ran any bulk jobs.
Ethan (Oncall): Handing off to next oncall for follow-up and RCA: @Liam, @Riley — please pick this up. I’ve added runbook notes and artifacts.
Liam (Eng-Platform): Taking handoff. I’ll coordinate the longform RCA draft. Action items: 1) Timeline reconstruction, 2) Root cause (tenant payload vs runtime bug), 3) Impact calc (tokens, error minutes, SLA windows), 4) Remediation and prevention.
Riley (Eng-Runtime): Initial root cause leans tenant misconfiguration (training job hitting inference endpoint), but runtime needs better hard-capping to avoid OOMs. Will add a dev ticket.
Asha (Security): Recommend sending a credential-safety notice to Elysian only if we see exfil indicators — none so far.
Nora (Customer Success): Drafting customer comms for execs: short exec summary + timeline + immediate mitigations + proposed credit. Will post draft for review.
Sam (Product): For credits: propose offering 10% credit for the incident window and an operational consult to prevent recurrence. Thoughts?
Liam (Eng-Platform): Put numbers first in the draft. Example: "We observed X minutes of elevated errors, affecting Y requests and Z% of your traffic. We recommend N credits."
Riley (Eng-Runtime): Technical follow-ups: enforce per-request token hard cap in the runtime (e.g., 100k tokens) and reject gracefully with 413. I’ll PR the change to runtime with tests.
Maya (SRE): I'll file the post-incident runbook update: include detection rule for anomalous request token counts and automated quarantine flow.
Nora (Customer Success): Draft (internal):
```
Nora (Customer Success): Hi Elysian team — quick update: We detected unusually large inference requests from an internal workflow that overloaded your dedicated pool (elysian-prod-1) at 10:17 UTC. We isolated the requests, scaled the pool, and applied temporary rate limits. Service normalized by 10:37 UTC. We will follow up with a full RCA and proposed credits. Apologies for the disruption.
```
Sam (Product): Good tone. Add: "If you want, we can schedule a 1:1 with infra/ML ops to review safe job patterns."
Nora (Customer Success): Will add and send after final approval.
Liam (Eng-Platform): I’ll own the RCA doc and exec summary; target EOD draft. Riley, can you attach the log snapshots and PR link for runtime change?
Riley (Eng-Runtime): Yep — attaching artifacts: `/var/incident/4267894021/*` and will push PR #2387.
Asha (Security): I’ll join the RCA review to validate there’s no security escalation.
Ethan (Oncall): Thanks team. Handed over; overnight watch is not required unless we see regression.
Maya (SRE): Closing the on-call bridge. Please keep the thread updated with RCA link and customer comms copy.
Liam (Eng-Platform): RCA doc draft saved: https://docs.internal/rca/4267894021 (will drop final link when ready).
Nora (Customer Success): Sent customer interim note. They replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick mitigation. We'll check our jobs and circle back."
Sam (Product): Note for credits: finance will need the minutes and request counts. Liam, include a CSV export.
Liam (Eng-Platform): Will attach CSV in the RCA.
Riley (Eng-Runtime): Action items assigned: runtime hard-cap PR (#2387), logging enhancement ticket (#2390), automated quarantine rule (#2391).
Maya (SRE): Actions for ops: update runbook, add detection alert, add test for quarantine flow in chaos tests.
Nora (Customer Success): Final: once RCA ready, I’ll send the exec summary and proposed credit to Elysian and coordinate any follow-up consult.
incident-bot: Thread closed by Maya (SRE) at 2026-03-15T11:12:00Z.
